page.content:
The Word is the sixth song on The Beatles album, Rubber Soul. The song is about the word, which is love, and what the true meaning of love really is. It features George Martin on Harmonium.

page.overview:
What is The Word?

The Word is the sixth song on The Beatles album, Rubber Soul. The song is about the word, which is love, and what the true meaning of love really is. It features George Martin on Harmonium.
